camel_example: aliyun cloudfw CreateApplicationCustomRules --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationTemplateId 'ati-4f0691c56b8d4f06' --Rules '[{"Priority":1,"ApplicationIds":[10012150000],"ApplicationCustomRuleName":"自定义规则01","RuleAction":"Deny"}]'
description_en: Creates custom rules in batches for a specified application template. You can create up to 100 rules at a time, and the total number of rules in the template cannot exceed 100
description_zh: 在指定应用程序模板下批量创建自定义规则。单次最多创建100条规则，且模板内规则总数不超过100条
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-application-custom-rules --application-template-id ati-4f0691c56b8d4f06 --rules '[{"Priority":1,"ApplicationIds":[10012150000],"ApplicationCustomRuleName":"自定义规则01","RuleAction":"Deny"}]' --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplicationCustomRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application template to which the custom rules belong. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 自定义规则所属的应用程序模板ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: application_template_id

fields.help_en: The name of the custom rule. The name cannot be empty and can be up to 64 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.)
fields.help_zh: 自定义规则名称。不能为空，长度不超过64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.）
fields.name: application_custom_rule_name

fields.help_en: The list of application IDs associated with the rule. A single rule can be associated with 1 to 200 applications. The IDs cannot be 0, must be unique, and must exist in the built-in application signature library. You can call the ListApplications operation to query the IDs
fields.help_zh: 规则关联的应用程序ID列表。单条规则关联1~200个应用，ID不能为0、不可重复，且必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用。可通过ListApplications查询
fields.name: application_ids

fields.help_en: The priority of the rule. Valid values: integers from 1 to 200. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same batch and the same template
fields.help_zh: 规则优先级。取值范围为1~200的整数，数值越小优先级越高。同一批次内以及同一模板内优先级均不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The action to perform when the rule is matched. Valid values:
Allow: allows the traffic.
Alert: monitors the traffic.
Deny: blocks the traffic
fields.help_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en: The list of custom rules for the application. You can specify up to 100 rules at a time, and the total number of rules in the template after creation must not exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序自定义规则列表。单次最多传入100条规则，且创建后模板内规则总数不超过100条
parameters.name: rules

ApplicationCustomRuleIds.description_en: The list of IDs for the newly created custom application rules. The order of the IDs corresponds to the order of the rules in the Rules request parameter
ApplicationCustomRuleIds.description_zh: 新建的应用程序自定义规则ID列表，与入参Rules的顺序一一对应

items.description_en: The ID of the custom application rule
